topics.answer: Ficungini is a tender intelligence workspace. It helps you decide whether to bid, surface compliance requirements, and organize the evidence needed to build a stronger response. It is made to amplify experienced tender consultants, EPC bid teams and procurement professionals, while keeping humans in control. It works for RFPs, RFQs, corrigenda and technical specifications across public procurement and private EPC or OEM bids.

The platform has two agent-powered workflows, **Bid Analysis** and **Craft Bid**, from profile-specific discovery to an evidence-checked bid.
- **Discovery:** tenders matched to your profile, with a notification only when the call is Go or Conditional Go
- **Market intelligence:** multi-parameter context, each finding traceable to its source
- **Strategy:** specialized AI assistance to work through tender complications and shape the bid strategy
- **Writing:** a human-assisted, evidence-checked bid writer, finalised in your niche's bid format and vocabulary
Both plans include Tender Intelligence, Tender Repository, and Bid Studio & Archive.

Ficungini brings Go/No-Go analysis, compliance flags and market intelligence together in one tender workspace. Every compliance conclusion is backed by evidence from the tender itself, and every recommendation is traceable, so your team can review, question and defend it. Discovery sends a notification only when a call is Go or Conditional Go.

Every compliance conclusion is backed by evidence from the tender itself, not a guess. Beyond the obvious requirements, Ficungini actively searches for missing qualifications, exemptions and alternative eligibility paths before you submit. It also keeps watch on tender portals, so every amendment, corrigendum and added document reaches you the moment it's published.

New tenders are matched against the specific profile of your firm or desk, not broadcast to everyone. Each opportunity is weighed against your capabilities, eligibility, sector and fit before it reaches your team. You choose how much you share to sharpen the match, and you can opt out of discovery entirely: it's never a requirement to use the rest of the platform.

Every market read is specific to the tender in front of you, not a recycled summary. It draws on current tender-traffic activity, research into historical patterns in that exact niche, competitive-bidding know-how suited to how the tender will play out, and the economics of that market. The aim is a commercial strategy grounded in evidence rather than a guess, with every finding traceable to its source.

Yes. Business workspaces give consultants, reviewers and sign-off leads a shared source of truth for tender documents, findings and bid decisions. Analysis and drafting happen in the same workspace, so several consultants can work the same tender without duplicating effort and keep evidence, analysis and drafts consistent. Business plans also include organizational deployment and priority support and onboarding.

A human is always in the loop. Ficungini proposes, checks and drafts, but every decision can be reviewed and overridden, and nothing reaches a submission without a human sign-off. Changing a validated item requires a reason, checked against existing evidence. Every recommendation is traceable, so nothing is a black box. The final call on strategy and submission stays with your consultants.

Ficungini works with any ERP that allows API access, with a one-click connection that you authorize once. Data moves over an encrypted API connection using GET requests only, in both directions: Ficungini can only read from your ERP, and your ERP can only read from Ficungini, and neither can create, change or delete anything in the other. Ficungini also runs any tender you upload directly, from any procuring authority and in any format.

There are two plans, and every capability is included in both.
- **Individual:** ₹9,999 a month plus applicable GST, with complete platform access and monthly usage limits
- **Business:** quoted around your team size, workspace needs and deployment scope. It adds collaborative workspaces, organizational deployment, and priority support and onboarding
Both include Tender Intelligence, Tender Repository, and Bid Studio & Archive. To get a Business quote, say "book a demo" and I'll take your details.
You get a complimentary tender analysis each day. After your daily free analysis you can wait for the next day's free one, or choose a paid plan to keep reviewing tenders.

Ficungini applies encryption, access controls and security monitoring to protect tender information, and your documents and analyses stay scoped to your organization's workspace.
- Customer workspaces are encrypted
- Data sent to or from Ficungini, including API and ERP integrations, uses encrypted channels
- Platform access requires TOTP authentication
- Data belonging to paid customers is not used to train general-purpose AI models

Ficungini is built for tender consultancies, independent consultants, and EPC and OEM bid teams. It works for RFPs, RFQs, corrigenda and technical specifications across public procurement and private EPC or OEM bids. It doesn't promise a higher win rate: it gives experienced teams a sharper instrument that removes the grinding manual work and the guesswork, while every final decision stays in human hands.

Ficungini is built by tender experts, for tender experts, with a mission to bring clarity and rigorous precision to public and private procurement worldwide. It is operated by Rith in India. The team is small and builds the platform end to end: Kevalkumar S Jadhav is the founder and Rashmi Badiger is a software engineer.

The documentation page has the benchmark methodology, case studies, blogs and workflow guides. The guides cover **Bid Analysis** (upload a tender and get a requirement-level read of eligibility, compliance and a Go/No-Go recommendation) and **Craft Bid** (turn an analysed tender into a structured, reviewable bid draft, with your team in the loop). The benchmark whitepaper is still being prepared.

topics.answer: The Privacy Policy (effective 29 September 2026) explains how Rith, operating the Ficungini platform, collects, uses, stores, protects and deletes information across its websites, applications, APIs, workspaces and discovery services. You can ask me about retention and deletion, model training, discovery, data sharing or your rights.

Ficungini does not use data belonging to paid customers to train, fine-tune or improve general-purpose AI or machine-learning models, and paid-customer content and profile information are not put into general-purpose training datasets. Your information may still be processed through model-based systems when that is needed to provide a service you requested or authorized.

keywords: how long is my data kept
topics.answer: After a tender reaches its designated closing state, its workspace documents are packaged into a ZIP archive and delivered through your authorized administrator, to an email address they choose. Once that export is complete, the documents are deleted from Ficungini's active servers. Backup or disaster-recovery systems may keep copies for a limited period under security controls until they are removed or overwritten. Ficungini does not intentionally keep closed-tender content indefinitely.

Profile-specific discovery needs your authorization: Ficungini does not silently build a profile from your information. When you enable it, the profile information you provide is used to find tenders relevant to your stated capabilities. You can choose not to authorize it, or withdraw later. Because discovery is built around your profile, it cannot operate without that authorization, and withdrawal does not undo lawful processing that happened before.

Ficungini does not sell customer content or profile information. It discloses information only where reasonably necessary for the purpose at hand. It may use third-party providers needed to run the platform, with contractual and technical controls, and it does not authorize them to use paid-customer data for general-purpose model training.

Depending on the law and your circumstances, you may have rights over your personal information. Ficungini intends to operate in line with Indian data-protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Where Ficungini processes data for an organization, that organization may decide the purposes of the processing and be responsible for answering some requests. Privacy questions go to privacy@ficungini.ai.
Privacy questions go to privacy@ficungini.ai, and questions about the Terms of Service go to legal@ficungini.ai. Ficungini is operated by Rith, in India.

The Terms of Service set out the rules for using Ficungini. You can ask me about who owns your content, how reliable the outputs are, what discovery results do and don't promise, or fees and subscriptions.

You keep your rights in your content. You give Ficungini a limited, non-exclusive right to host, process and analyze it only as needed to provide the services and the processing you authorize, to maintain and secure the service, prevent abuse, give support, comply with the law and enforce the Terms. Ficungini does not acquire ownership of your content just because you upload it.

Outputs such as requirement analysis, compliance findings, evidence matching, reports and summaries come from the information available to the service, and may not be complete, accurate, current or error-free. Review them yourself before relying on them for legal, financial, commercial, regulatory or procurement decisions. Generating an output does not mean Ficungini is giving legal, financial, tax, accounting or regulatory advice.

Discovery results help you find potentially relevant opportunities. Ficungini does not guarantee that a tender suits you, that you are eligible or meet every requirement, that it will stay open, that it will be awarded to you, or that results are complete. You remain responsible for verifying requirements, deadlines, eligibility and commercial conditions.

Paid services need subscription or usage fees. Fees, billing periods, taxes, usage limits and payment terms are shown at purchase or set in your order form or customer agreement. Unless stated otherwise, fees are non-refundable, except where the law requires a refund or it is agreed in writing. Pricing for future subscription periods can change with reasonable notice.
